q: Which fuel needed the smallest mass?
Calculate the energy per gram for methanol.
Describe the trend in energy per gram.
It increases with more carbon atoms, but each step adds less (6.5, then 3.3, then 2.2 kJ/g).
Name two variables that must be controlled to make the test fair.
Same mass of water, same distance from flame to can, same can, same temperature rise, draught shield.
Real values are about 50% higher. Suggest whether the ranking can still be trusted.
Probably yes: all fuels lost energy in the same set-up, so the order is fair even though the values are low. Repeats would make it more certain.
